WITH state_values AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT state_values_source.s_state
    FROM (
        VALUES
            ('TN'),
            ('TN'),
            ('TN'),
            ('TN'),
            ('TN'),
            ('TN')
    ) AS state_values_source(s_state)
),
materialized_result AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        item.i_item_id,
        store.s_state,
        GROUPING(store.s_state) AS g_state,
        AVG(store_sales.ss_quantity) AS agg1,
        AVG(store_sales.ss_list_price) AS agg2,
        AVG(store_sales.ss_coupon_amt) AS agg3,
        AVG(store_sales.ss_sales_price) AS agg4
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN customer_demographics
      ON store_sales.ss_cdemo_sk = customer_demographics.cd_demo_sk
     AND customer_demographics.cd_gender = 'M'
     AND customer_demographics.cd_marital_status = 'W'
     AND customer_demographics.cd_education_status = 'Secondary'
    JOIN date_dim
      ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
     AND date_dim.d_year = 1999
    JOIN store
      ON store_sales.ss_store_sk = store.s_store_sk
    JOIN state_values
      ON store.s_state = state_values.s_state
    JOIN item
      ON store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (item.i_item_id, store.s_state)
)
SELECT
    i_item_id,
    s_state,
    g_state,
    agg1,
    agg2,
    agg3,
    agg4
FROM materialized_result
ORDER BY i_item_id, s_state
LIMIT 100
